Keycloak._comment: Authority is the realm issuer, the same value the API uses. It is also the authorization server this MCP server advertises to clients.
Keycloak._comment2: RequireHttpsMetadata is false only because Authority is loopback (the local Docker lab). The server refuses to start if this is false for a non-loopback authority.

Mcp._comment: ResourceUrl is this server's canonical URL. It is three things at once: the RFC 8707 resource clients name, the only audience this server accepts, and the server's Keycloak client_id (see infra/terraform/20-realm/mcp.tf for why). ClientSecret has no default: `make mcp` reads it from Terraform.
